hook_line: UK SETTLEMENT WAIT DOUBLES TO 10 YEARS

hook_stat.sub: Standard wait for UK settlement, doubled from five years

stats.label: Care workers earning at least this a year keep a five-year route
Earn more than this a year and settlement takes three years
People due to settle at five years who will not now do so

diaspora_bullets: The new wait applies retrospectively to workers already in Britain
Many public sector workers — doctors, nurses and teachers — also stay at five years
news_summary: Home Secretary Shabana Mahmood's plan doubles the standard UK settlement wait from five years to ten, applied retrospectively, while care workers earning at least £25,000 keep a five-year route.
payoff: UK settlement is now earned by contribution, not just time served.
